GeekClaw v5.0.25 - Fresh Install WebView2 Robustness

Fixes
- Installer no longer aborts when WebView2 bootstrapper cannot be downloaded.
  On failure it now shows a clear recovery message and continues installing GeekClaw.
- Installer detects an existing WebView2 runtime by physical file in
  C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\EdgeWebView\Application\*\msedgewebview2.exe
  in addition to the EdgeUpdate registry keys. This avoids false negatives on
  fresh corporate images where Edge was never opened.
- Switched webviewInstallMode to "offlineInstaller" so the WebView2 Evergreen
  Standalone Installer is bundled inside the GeekClaw installer (~127 MB
  overhead). New machines no longer need internet access to install GeekClaw.

Compatibility
- Existing installs are unaffected.
- The installer will still fall back to the bundled bootstrapper /
  standalone installer if the runtime is missing.
